summary: Tested SWIPEUPCAR mobile improvements (burger nav + account tabs) at 390px and 1280px. Found and fixed one CRITICAL bug: in assets/app.js the toggleNavMenu function and the outside-click listener were written as raw JS text INSIDE the #navMenu div template literal (no <script> tag wrapper). Result: JS was rendered as visible text inside the menu AND toggleNavMenu was undefined -> the burger button did NOTHING on click. Fix applied: (1) removed the raw JS lines from the innerHTML template of renderNav, (2) added toggleNavMenu + outside-click document listener at the top of app.js (global scope). After the fix, all functional tests pass on all 4 role pages.

ui_bugs.issue: toggleNavMenu function declared as raw text inside a template-literal-innerHTML (no <script> tag). Function never registered on window, burger button non-functional; JS code was visibly rendered as text inside the #navMenu panel.

action_items: Review the fix applied in /app/frontend/public/swipeupcar/assets/app.js (toggleNavMenu moved to top-level global scope). Consider consolidating all inline scripts into a proper <script> block or module.
critical_code_review_comments: renderNav() (app.js) mixes HTML template with inline JS that requires a <script> tag; safer to define helpers globally instead of embedding in innerHTML.
app.js is a single ~170-line file — fine for now, but nav/rendering helpers could be split for maintainability.
The 4 account HTML pages duplicate sidebar markup; consider centralizing renderSidebar().

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: raw JavaScript code (function toggleNavMenu + document click listener) was placed directly inside a template-literal HTML string that is assigned to element.innerHTML via renderNav(). Because innerHTML does not execute embedded <script> tags at all, and because the code was not even wrapped in <script>, the JS was interpreted as plain text and inserted as text nodes inside the #navMenu container. Consequence: toggleNavMenu was never defined -> onclick="toggleNavMenu(event)" on the burger button threw ReferenceError silently, so the menu never opened; additionally the raw JS text was visible in the open panel. Reproduction (pre-fix): open /swipeupcar/index.html at 390px, tap the ☰ button -> nothing happens; inspect #navMenu innerHTML -> raw function text visible. Mitigation applied: (1) removed the raw code from the innerHTML template inside renderNav, (2) defined toggleNavMenu and the outside-click listener at the top of assets/app.js (loaded via <script src>), so they run once at script load and are globally accessible from the inline onclick handler.
